steps.caption: Remove every 6. A dummy node before the head means even the head is removed the same way as any other node.
pre.next is 6: skip it with pre.next = pre.next.next. Don't move pre; the new next might also be 6.
pre.next is 1: keep it, move pre forward.
pre.next is 6: skip it with pre.next = pre.next.next. Don't move pre; the new next might also be 6.
pre.next is 2: keep it, move pre forward.
Return dummy.next as the new head. No special case for removing the first node.
